question: Can repeated guarded funding continue after exact host-established credit without erasing spent allocation, obligations or fences?
evidence_class: Source implementation, native checks and actual local PocketIC calls using synthetic Cashier and host credit facts; no deployed-provider qualification

source.head: ebd535eaa2015407319fd330f559b2808ea01588
source.note: Implementation extends the existing dirty pending release. Cargo metadata and maintainer-selected lock remain unchanged. Earlier memory 0.27.0 and released-image evidence retains its original identity.

contract.boundary: Host-internal workflow::funding::credit::confirm and StableFundingJournal::record_credit; no production ingress credit setter.
contract.bindings: Full original intent, positive exact transport-accepted amount, nonzero SHA-256 fingerprint of independently authenticated uniquely attributable immutable provider credit evidence.
contract.replay: Identical confirmation is idempotent. Conflicting amount/fingerprint or reuse across local intents refuses before writes. Unknown, unsent or fully refunded attachments cannot be confirmed.
contract.accounting: Lifetime accepted remains spent. Separate credit_confirmed totals determine outstanding uncredited acceptance; no budget replenishment, uncertainty erasure, increased capacity or unfencing.
contract.recovery: Intent and accounting writes share IC rollback; reopen validates exact receipts, unique fingerprints and recomputed totals, then fences even exact replay.
contract.hard_cut: Mandatory persisted credit/accounting fields, mandatory uncredited_accepted status field, CreditConfirmed outcome variant, generated Candid, matching codecs and installation:platform-anchor-funding-credit format; prior formats refuse.

new_local_cases.repeat: Two actual Cashier requests, operations 1 and 2, accept 300 then 200 cycles. Exact first receipt permits second dispatch; aggregate lifetime acceptance stays 500, available allocation 500; second acceptance needs its own distinct receipt.
new_local_cases.rollback: FundingAccounting write trap after the receipt write preserves every stable byte and CreditRequired. Retrying confirmation succeeds without another provider request.
new_local_cases.refusal: Wrong authority, namespace, original offer, amount, neutral digest, changed receipt and cross-operation reuse preserve stable bytes.
new_local_cases.restoration: Actual same-image upgrade preserves receipt and totals, opens fenced and rejects exact confirmation replay.

validation: Actual Rust 1.88 native and Wasm compilation: msrv-native-01.log, msrv-wasm-01.log
Generated Candid equals maintained export: candid-test-01.log

failed_attempts.reason: Protocol receipt fields needed public documentation and its renderer needed the added variant; fixed and fixture-check-03.log passes.
Larger views crossed value-passing threshold; callers now borrow. Simplified acceptance predicate. clippy-03/04/05 pass.
Two native local HTTP tests could not bind sockets in sandbox; all 98 pass with loopback permission in cli-tests-03.log.
Two consumer and two gateway-source cases lacked explicit fixture paths. Built/froze matching fixture dependencies and retried only those four cases; original remaining cases passed.
Initial raw-manifest assembly included its own output path. Preserved that manifest; final manifest excludes itself and all 124 listed files verify.

retention.notes: Requests and normal replies are raw Candid; credit-trap-result.candid retains textual RejectResponse bytes despite its suffix. Stable snapshots and observed original Cashier requests are retained per new case. No failed evidence is replaced.

limitations: Host facts/fingerprints are synthetic and not self-authenticating. Actual provider evidence, authority, unique attribution and account-wide completeness remain host qualification work.
Toko/Canic source was not changed. Consumer adoption, repeated production dispatch and upload verifier configuration remain their owners' work.
Fresh receipt reuse checks scan configured bounded lifetime history; scale/production confirmation costs and new receipt-populated restore tiers are not measured by this four-intent fixture.
Zero additional stable grants; local receipt uniqueness does not establish global uniqueness across installations.
Linux native/local runtime checks do not establish native macOS execution. Earlier supported-host records remain historical.
Cross-release upgrades and active stale backups remain unsupported. Retire original provider objects, balances and billing obligations before reinstall.
